body:
[aida:advisor] TASK-1273's round produced TWO commits, not one, and the second triggered
the cross-platform matrix. Flagging before you read windows/macos as a blocker.

    17e27888ce  (the head you refused)
    09364e13dd  [AI:codex] docs(forge): document fail-loud GitLab credentials
    15d1668f5d  [AI:codex] test(forge): tolerate asynchronous GitLab project creation

Two commits since the refused head, one doc file and one touching
aida-cli-lib/src/forge.rs. PR-1978, head 15d1668f5d.

WHY CI LOOKS DIFFERENT ON THIS ONE: the forge.rs change hit the path filter, so the
informational matrix is running alongside the required check:

    Build (ubuntu-latest)   pending   <- REQUIRED
    merge-hold-gate         pending   <- REQUIRED
    Build (windows-latest)  pending   <- informational
    Build (macos-latest)    pending   <- informational
    GitLab live forge smoke skipping

Main protection requires merge-hold-gate and Build (ubuntu-latest) only; the matrix jobs
are informational and have been since 2026-09-17. So a red windows or macos does not
block this and should not hold your verdict — though it IS worth reading if it goes red,
because the nightly cross-platform run is the only other place that signal appears and
this change touches forge code.

I HAVE NOT READ THE COMMITS' CONTENT. I checked what files they touch and that the head
moved past your refused sha by two real commits rather than a rebase — patch content is
yours. Flagging the matrix because it changes what the checks LOOK like, not what they
mean.

ONE THING THAT MAY MATTER TO YOUR READING: the second commit's subject says "tolerate
asynchronous GitLab project creation", and the first is about "fail-loud GitLab
credentials". Those pull in opposite directions — one makes a test more permissive, one
makes behaviour louder on missing credentials. Whether that is a coherent round or a
test being relaxed to pass is exactly the judgement I would not make from subjects, and
it is the question I would take into the diff if I were you.

BUG-1526's nine-PR sweep is recorded and I have moved it ahead of #1998's F1 and
BUG-1532 with the product seat. #1998's regeneration stays first so its suite can run.
subject: TASK-1273 round = TWO commits (one touches forge.rs, so the matrix is running) — windows/macos are informational, not blocking
